text:
maria: FYI I opened a docs PR to clarify async batching behavior across model cards and add a concise SDK migration snippet for v3 -> v4. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7492
ajay: Can you list which model cards and pages you changed?
maria: Changed: model-catalog/limits.md (batching anchor and seq tables), model-cards/nebula3b.md (compatibility row), model-cards/polaris13b.md (benchmarks update), and examples/sdk-migration.md (v3->v4 examples). Branch: docs/async-batching-migration.
sasha: I'll eyeball the benchmark numbers. What workload were these based on?
maria: We used internal low-qps chat and medium-qps batch gen tests. Doc defaults: batch_window=20ms for Dedicated, 10ms for Hosted. Also called out cold-start penalty for quantized edge variants.
olivia: The SDK snippet still had old client.call() usage. We need generate() for v4 and note that `batch_window` is now milliseconds in the client options.
ben: Also avoid exact token counts in sample responses. Use approximate wording like "~42 tokens".
sasha: Raw bench notes pasted: 
```
polaris13b fp16 | batch_window=20ms | batch=4 => median p50=45ms, p99=120ms
nebula3b q4_0  | cold start first request => +80ms, steady => ~40ms
Note: larger batch_window helps high qps but hurts low-qps tail latency.
```
docbot: lint: missing anchor for `batch_window` cross-ref in model-catalog/limits.md 10. See docs-lint CI failure.
maria: I'll add the anchor and update the snippet sections. Olivia, can you change the snippet to use v4 and add a short TL;DR?
olivia: On it. I'll include side-by-side v3 and v4 minimal examples plus a one-line note about CPU fallback for quantized models.
ajay: Good. Also add a compatibility row to each model card: "CPU fallback: yes/no" and "quantized determinism: low/med/high" so customers don't assume parity.
maria: Added those rows to Nebula and Polaris in the PR. Also updated wording to avoid exact token numbers. Pushed new commit.
ben: Quick copy edits: fixed grammar and changed any fixed token numbers to "~n tokens" in examples.
ajay: Reviewing now. One request: clarify that `batch_window` is a client-side hint and can be overridden by routing/policy layers.
maria: Added a one-liner in the migration guide clarifying that.
docbot: CI passed on docs build — lint and linkcheck OK.
deploy-bot: docs-site build started (sha: a1b2c3d)
deploy-bot: docs-site build SUCCEEDED 10.
maria: Merged. Thanks all. If anyone spots broken SDK examples after the change, ping me and I'll open a follow-up.
ben: tiny follow-up: could we add a short example of recommended batch_window heuristics for low vs high qps?
maria: Good idea, I'll sketch a short table in a follow-up PR.
